name: Blue Abadi Fund grant facilities
summary: Sub-grants for Papuan local organisations doing marine conservation in the Bird's Head Seascape, through primary, medium-scale and small-scale innovation facilities. The amount shown is for the Primary facility only. The page gives no application dates.

amount.note: Primary Grant Facility only, per cycle; smaller facilities give less

applicant_types.quote: Civil society organizations in Papua, including non-profit organizations, community groups, religious organizations, business cooperatives, and customary councils, operating in BLKB.

geography.quote: Local organizations based in Papua and operating in BLKB

amount.quote: Primary Grant Facility Grant Cycle: Sub-grant annually or multi-year Grant Value: USD 25,000 - USD 500,000 per cycle
